title: 🎉 Paper Accepted by IEEE IROS
excerpt: Our paper "HeteroTac-Lift: Empirical Lift Admission via Heterogeneous Bilateral Tactile Servoing and Risk-Budgeted Compliance" has been accepted by IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS).
